$comment: PROPOSED, NOT ADMITTED. A frozen description of one logic kernel's interface and vocabulary. Dispositions, grades, and digests are NOT portable between kernels, so every WarrantArtifact declares the kernel_profile_id it was produced under and OIC never compares artifacts across profiles. Nothing in this file imports, executes, or calls ZTL.

conformance_fixture_set.provenance: Published by the ZTL side under ZTL-OIC-WO-002; reproduced against the pinned commit by its author (Tier 3). Independent Tier-1 reproduction remains OPEN.

disposition_values.meaning: Grounded outright. The verdict cannot move under any further verification, and unverified atoms are irrelevant.
True only while an unverified atom holds. The verdict rides that atom and can die when it resolves. Omitted from ZTL dossier v0.1; added after measurement.
Not established; a mark actually matters. Never carries raw verdict T.

known_interface_hazards.consequence: A caller that grades through zverify.grade with the judge() alphabet receives `hereditary` where the correct grade is `until-verification`. That is a silent upgrade of a conditional result to the strongest warranty, which would let OIC treat ON CREDIT as EARNED and authorise action on an unverified link.
known_interface_hazards.mitigation: OIC consumes judge() only. zverify.grade is a prohibited entrypoint under this profile.
known_interface_hazards.summary: zverify.grade expects 'M' for a mark while judge() accepts 'Z'. Passing 'Z' directly to grade returns a wrong grade SILENTLY.

known_interface_hazards.consequence: An adapter reading raw_verdict instead of disposition records 'established false' for something merely unverified, violating I-03.
known_interface_hazards.mitigation: disposition is the only field that may drive a decision. raw_verdict is recorded for replay and is inert.
known_interface_hazards.summary: raw_verdict can be 'F' while disposition is 'OPEN' (measured: judge("p & q", {p:T, q:Z})).

known_interface_hazards.consequence: The kernel reports a verdict for a different question under the old name, undetectably.
known_interface_hazards.mitigation: Atom identity is the caller's responsibility. OIC binds ground identifiers to source anchors and admission records outside the kernel.
known_interface_hazards.summary: Atom identifiers are supplied by the caller and echoed verbatim. Re-pointing an identifier at a different source clause is invisible to the kernel.

known_interface_hazards.consequence: A mapping written against the three-value list silently misclassifies ON CREDIT, most likely as EARNED.
known_interface_hazards.mitigation: disposition_values above is the frozen list of four. An unknown disposition is OIC-W-0022.
known_interface_hazards.summary: ZTL dossier v0.1 documented three dispositions; the kernel has four.

known_interface_hazards.consequence: `hereditary` treated as 'settled forever' would skip revalidation that the grade never promised.
known_interface_hazards.mitigation: ADR-013 W-4 conditions 3 to 8 revalidate epoch, expiry, revocation, versions, and profiles independently of the grade.
known_interface_hazards.summary: `hereditary` is absorbing under monotone refinement ONLY. It does not waive re-checking on expiry, revocation, correction, source invalidation, schema change, formula change, semantic-version change, or admissibility change.

not_reachable_combinations.reason: EARNED requires grade hereditary by construction. A T verdict that is only sound is classified ON CREDIT.
Same: a non-hereditary T is ON CREDIT.
OPEN never carries raw T. Exhaustive search over the formula pool found no counterexample.

presentational_fields.rule: Human-readable justification. Do not parse. May change without a profile version bump.

prohibited_entrypoints.reason: Different marking dialect ('M' rather than 'Z'). Silently returns an incorrect warranty grade when called with the judge() alphabet.

signed_tag.limitations: The key is new, unattested by any third party, and held without a passphrase on a workstation. It is not a hardware-backed identity and must not be described as one.
signed_tag.name: veraxis-ztl-input-v0.1.1-signed

status: PROPOSED - frozen interface description, not admitted

warranty_grade_values.meaning: Invariant under every admissible monotone refinement of the same formula and marking.
Never lies about the present marking, but may stall under refinement.
Holds only in the present marking; not yet settled.
